label: Playconomics Textbook
description: Local Playconomics Introduction to Macroeconomics, third edition.

label: Week 1 Lecture 1
description: Aggregate production, GDP, nominal and real output, and business cycles.

label: Week 1 Lecture 2
description: CPI, inflation, labour-force statistics, unemployment, potential output, and Okun's law.

label: Week 2 Lecture 1
description: Labour demand and supply, wages, nominal and real interest rates, and the Fisher effect.

label: Week 2 Lecture 2
description: Investment, capital, user cost, household saving, national saving, and crowding out.

label: Week 3 Lecture 1
description: Planned aggregate expenditure, inventories, consumption, and the income-expenditure model.

label: Week 3 Lecture 2
description: The multiplier, open-economy leakages, and paradox of thrift.

label: Week 4 Lecture 1
description: Government sector, fiscal multipliers, and balanced-budget effects.

label: Week 4 Lecture 2
description: Fiscal policy timing, deficits, debt, and stabilisation.

label: Week 5 Lecture 1
description: Financial assets, bond pricing, money, and private banks.

label: Week 5 Lecture 2
description: Central banks, the RBA, the cash rate, Exchange Settlement Accounts, corridor operations, and open-market operations.

label: Week 7 Lecture 1
description: The term structure, expectations, nominal and real rates, policy rules, and monetary transmission through PAE.

label: Week 7 Lecture 2
description: Aggregate demand, aggregate supply, inflation dynamics, and policy responses.

label: Week 8 Lecture 1
description: Balance of payments, small open economies, saving, investment, and net exports.

label: Week 8 Lecture 2
description: Nominal and real exchange rates, PPP, the AUD market, and fixed exchange rates.

label: Week 9 Lecture 1
description: Economic growth, production functions, productivity, and growth accounting.
